title: the old shared service token refused outside DEV and TEST (card 9g-13)
note: no container was started (no Docker daemon): the compose overlay was read and the installer's lines were run as they stand with the real secrets init

findings.claim: the token layer passes the old shared token on to any app named orchestrator, and to any changing call of an app named gateway, outside DEV and TEST; the real orchestrator's route gate and the real gateway refuse it with an audit event (D-464, D-437), but a test app or a future app under those names that lacks their checks would accept it

a PRODUCTION box with no token registry (installed before step 8 and never re-installed) now loses every service, not only the orchestrator; doctor's legacy_token FAILs and the update preflight refuses there, but the fix also needs an install re-run to put the secrets overlay in COMPOSE_FILE, which the fix line does not say

an update applied by an older release's update code does not run the new preflight refusal; the box then refuses the old token without doctor having been run, though no service of an overlay box presents it
